errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Deletes every dev.knotless.follow record naming the account from the account logged in to this appview's web pages, if any. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

description: Unfollows an account as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
